title: fix(objectql, lint): synced objects are told to drop write verbs, not to open userActions
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XThwtS6EW9nZLU4U913YL1G)_

Fixes #32134

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`managedBy: 'synced'` 对象上,注册时剥除写动词的告警和 lint 规则 `object/managed-api-method-unaffordable` 的报错/修复行,不再让作者去 `userActions` 打开写权限,改为:列出要从 `enable.apiMethods` 删掉的动词,写入走声明的 action(ADR-0153 D5)。`os explain` 多一段说明。其他 bucket 的文字逐字不变。
- 为什么改:#32118 之后,`synced` 对象上 `userActions` 打开写动词会在 parse 时被拒(ADR-0153 D4)。旧文案让作者去改 `userActions`,改完构建又报错,两条信息互相矛盾,作者无路可走。
- 风险与回滚:只改文案,剥除行为、规则判定、规则 id/严重度/path、schema 都不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/lint/src/validate-managed-api-methods.ts` 的 `writeLocked` 分支;`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` `reconcileManagedApiMethods` 的 `remedy`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-managed-api-methods.test.ts`,预期 15 条全绿(含 synced 的两条新钉子)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Both sentences branch on `MANAGED_BY_WRITE_LOCKED_BUCKETS` (`@objectstack/spec/data`, today `synced` alone), the same set the parse refusal (`refuseWriteLockedUserActions`), `resolveCrudAffordances` and the core `/me/permissions` clamp already read, so the remedy text and the refusal can never disagree about which bucket is locked.

- **`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` `reconcileManagedApiMethods`.** On a write-locked bucket the warning's remedy reads: "userActions cannot open a write on this bucket (ADR-0153 D4): remove [VERBS] from enable.apiMethods and send writes through a declared action (ADR-0153 D5)." Every other bucket keeps "Declare userActions to open a verb the object legitimately takes from a user context." The rest of the line (object, bucket, stripped and kept verbs, the lint rule id) and the strip are unchanged.
- **`packages/lint/src/validate-managed-api-methods.ts` (`object/managed-api-method-unaffordable`).** On a write-locked bucket the verdict reads "`enable.apiMethods` advertises [VERBS], which `managedBy: 'synced'` refuses, and `userActions` cannot open a write there, so the registry strips them", and the fix line reads "Remove [VERBS] from `enable.apiMethods`, and send writes through a declared action". Every other bucket keeps "(needs userActions …)" and both ways out. Rule id, severity, `where`, `path` and the verdict itself are unchanged.
- **`packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`.** `os explain object/managed-api-method-unaffordable` gains one paragraph: on `synced` `userActions` cannot open a write (ADR-0153 D4), so the fix line offers only the removal, and a write goes through a declared action (ADR-0153 D5).
- **`.changeset/32134-synced-remedy-text.md`**: `@objectstack/objectql` patch, `@objectstack/lint` patch. Both packages ship `dist/` (`files: [dist, README.md, CHANGELOG.md]`); the new text is in `packages/objectql/dist/index.js` and `packages/lint/dist/index.js` after build.

**File surface.** The order named `managed-api-affordance.ts`'s `describeManagedApiMethodConflicts` as the lint sentence's source. Measured on `origin/main` `f068cde8`: the lint rule no longer reads it (it builds its own message and hint, `validate-managed-api-methods.ts` L110-114, and its CHANGELOG records the switch), and the helper has no production caller, only its own test. The seat amended the claim's surface to the lint rule, its test and the explain paragraph, and ruled the spec helper out of this PR (no parameter added to an export nobody calls). No `packages/spec` file moves, so there is no spec changeset.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/registry.test.ts`: a `synced` fixture pins the whole warning line; a control on `engine-owned` pins today's line byte for byte.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-managed-api-methods.test.ts`: a `synced` fixture pins the whole verdict, and one with every write verb pins the whole fix line (and that it never says `userActions`); the existing exact pins on `platform` (verdict) and `better-auth` (fix line) are the controls and are unchanged. The explanation's fact list gains `ADR-0153 D4` and `ADR-0153 D5`. Both synced cases are recorded by the file's one-line, at-most-200-characters checks.

<details><summary>Ablation: each synced branch forced off, red, restored (head f127667d)</summary>

Both suites import the subject from `src/` (`./registry`, `./validate-managed-api-methods`); `MANAGED_BY_WRITE_LOCKED_BUCKETS` comes from spec's built `dist/` and was not mutated, so no rebuild sits in either leg.

```text
registry.ts: "const remedy = MANAGED_BY_WRITE_LOCKED_BUCKETS.has(managedBy)" -> "const remedy = false"
  anchor x1 -> x0, replacement x0 -> x1, blob eb3b6f1d1036 -> 856148d4ab92
  x on a synced object, the warning names the verbs to drop and a declared action, never userActions
  Tests 1 failed | 106 passed (107)
  ok restored: blob == HEAD (eb3b6f1d1036) and `git diff HEAD` is empty

validate-managed-api-methods.ts: "const writeLocked = MANAGED_BY_WRITE_LOCKED_BUCKETS.has(bucket);" -> "const writeLocked = false;"
  blob 682b98ae055e -> 6f513b203589
  x on a synced object, the verdict says userActions cannot open a write, never "needs userActions"
  x on a synced object, the fix line offers only the removal and a declared action
  Tests 2 failed | 13 passed (15)
  ok restored: blob == HEAD (682b98ae055e) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```

Control leg on the base: `registry.ts` at `f068cde8` with this PR's test file, `-t reconcileManagedApiMethods`: only the synced pin fails (Tests 1 failed | 17 passed | 89 skipped), so the engine-owned control pins the line `main` prints today. Restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The spec helper still says "(needs userActions …)".** `describeManagedApiMethodConflicts` (`packages/spec/src/data/managed-api-affordance.ts` L142-150) takes only the conflicts, which carry no bucket, and nothing in the platform calls it any more. Left as it is by the seat's ruling; reported to the seat to card.
- **No generated reference or skill renders either sentence.** `git grep` for the rule id and for "Declare userActions" over `skills/`, `content/` and `docs/` answers nothing, so nothing is regenerated.
